notes.title: Patch: Difficulty and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello fellow hamster slayers.  There is a new build available that I hope addresses some player feedback.

- Lowered cost of unlocking some knights
- Lower star requirement for all location unlocks
- Lowered gold requirement for tier 2 melee and ranged weapons
-- ranged weapon 20g -> 10g
-- melee weapon 30g ->25g
- Increased the auto-attack rate from 0.2secs to 0.125secs.  This should help with input fatigue.
- Unlocking upgrade will now grant upgrade without needing to touch trigger
- Added message to map screen to clearly state the stars required to advance.
- Treasury is available after talking to king
- Pressing "A" or "Y" button will attempt to buy locked knight.
- Tutorial dumps you back into castle
- Fixed bug where tutorial revealed grassy plains before it revealed happy valley
- Fixed spelling error in the zoo.
